mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which signals a broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real estate sales (HOUST) over three months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals a recessionary environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) inflation is rising, it indicates a high-interest rate environment with increasing prices, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high-interest rate environment with rising inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and UNRATE decreases
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over three months signals a strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
